title: Not just for moths!
text: Not just for moths!. These came right on time as expected. They're moth balls- but the hanging type is convenient.  I actually bought them because I went to get my brand-new car serviced and apparently a mouse had gotten up in my engine and started eating the insulation in my engine cover! The car dealer suggested I hang this in my hood via zip tie to keep mice away (because they hate the smell) and they get up inside a warm car when it's cold out! Who knew? Worked like a charm!

SAY GOODBYE TO INDOOR BUG PROBLEMS: Flies, bees, roaches, moths, and mosquitos all have one thing in common--they aren't welcome in your home. From flyswatters to moth balls, cedar spray to roach powder, we have your pest repellent needs covered.
